faq.1.a: Yes, guarded parking behind a barrier. Ask about terms and price when booking.
faq.2.a: Yes. The family cabin fits two adults and one child: a double bed and a sofa bed. For a large family there is the Captain's cabin.
faq.3.a: A cabin is a separate room. Crew quarters are beds in a shared 8-bed room: bunk beds, each bunk is screened from the others and has its own lamp, socket and shelf. Rooms are separate for men and women.

faq.4.a: Yes, a kitchen-lounge: stove, microwave, kettle, water filter, ironing board and iron.
